body: C29 is landed and pushed (eea0fb2/5e1578f are on origin/master; your two push-approval messages are cleared, nothing is pending). R44 landed after it (b4b2207 + e26823d), so pull before you start. New task: research/TASK_C30.md. C23's post-fight read only exists while fight_state is alive - the log dies with the ring, so a bout can be read exactly once and only if the player watched it. New pure BoutRead.gd, an additive stamp on the record path at GameState.gd:2390, and get_bout_read(athlete_id, bout_index) beside :9620. No UI (Claude holds FightResultPanel.gd and FightNightScreen.gd for R45), no scoring edits, no backfill, no save migration. Sonnet, effort medium, Fast off. Test: --script tests/bout_read_test.gd, then the full suite - the record path is central.
